name: Motobu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Motobu town emblem in orange: a winged device above a ring enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Motobu, a town in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 December 1966.

features.role: Motobu town emblem — a winged device above a ring enclosing a stylised character
